response.rationale: R1 has direct raw support from the vignette: heliotrope rash, proximal muscle weakness, elevated CK, anti-SAE antibodies, and Wong-type skin biopsy, which together are pathognomonic for dermatomyositis. rejected.why: No raw support spans; anti-SSA antibody is non-specific and not sufficient for Sjögren syndrome without sicca symptoms or other objective findings.
CT chest findings are non-specific and not accompanied by raw support for rheumatoid arthritis-associated ILD; the clinical presentation is dominated by myositis and rash.
Hepatitis B/C history and elevated transaminases are chronic and not specific for autoimmune hepatitis; no raw support for autoimmune hepatitis features.
